chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 436: The Seamless Gate's deadly offer and a Yama King's secret
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate offers the Shaoyan clan a deal to kill Ji Ning. Four Celestial Immortals ambush Mu Northson. Yan Wang reveals his role as a Yama King.
og_title: A Deadly Deal and an Underworld King
og_description: The Seamless Gate's web tightens around Ji Ning as Celestial Immortals set a trap for his junior brother.
twitter_description: Four Celestial Immortals lie in wait for Mu Northson. Yan Wang drops a shocking truth.

lore_anchors.definition: A vast and secretive organization that operates throughout the Grand Xia Dynasty, opposing the imperial Xiamang clan and recruiting powerful local sects and tribes.
A Celestial Immortal of the Shaoyan clan, known for his cautious and calculating nature, holding a position of significant authority within the tribe.
In Chinese Buddhist and Daoist cosmology, the ten judges of the underworld who preside over the courts of Diyu, evaluating the sins of the dead and dictating their reincarnation.
The highest tier of magic treasure in the known universe, surpassing even Immortal-ranked items. Such treasures are often ancient heirlooms with immense, devastating power.
A formidable Celestial Immortal of the Shaoyan clan, recognized as one of the strongest among their ranks, assigned to lead the assassination squad against Ji Ning.
One of the supreme Dao rulers of the Three Realms, a powerful Celestial Immortal who has established his own small-scale cycle of reincarnation for the worlds under his protection.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't the Shaoyan clan just accept the Seamless Gate's help?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Accepting Seamless Gate's help means openly defying the Grand Xia royal clan and the Daofathers behind them, risking total annihilation. The offer is a poisoned chalice.
A localized version of the Six Paths of Reincarnation, created by a Daofather to govern the souls of the worlds under their direct control, bypassing the main, universal cycle.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Seamless Gate's information reliable?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, the Seamless Gate has demonstrated superior intelligence-gathering abilities, which is why the Shaoyan clan trusts the map of Mu Northson's location.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How strong are the four Celestial Immortals compared to Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Very strong. They are ancient elites with clan-guarding treasures, and they plan to use layered formations to trap him, showing they do not underestimate him.
